card.name: Word after comma in fixed label phrases
card.fires_on: The word right after a comma in two repeated label sentences: "including" after "deterioration of renal function," and "an" (start of anorexia) after "nausea, vomiting,".

modes.label: Renal function warning
modes.description: The word "including" after "deterioration of renal function," in the NSAID and angiotensin receptor blocker interaction sentence.
modes.example: may result in deterioration of renal function,<< including>> possible acute renal failure.

modes.label: Adrenal insufficiency symptoms
modes.description: The "an" that begins "anorexia" in the list of symptoms after "nausea, vomiting,".
modes.example: non-specific symptoms and signs including nausea, vomiting,<< an>>orexia, fatigue, weakness, d

card.writes: The promoted tokens (false, ineffective, avoidance) do not fit the text, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on a few exact phrases in drug labels, at the word that follows a comma in kidney-function and adrenal-symptom sentences.
